content:
I formalized the characterization of smooth steady states for the Vlasov-Maxwell-Landau system with Coulomb collisions on T³. The main result: the only smooth positive steady states are spatially uniform Gaussians. The formalization consists of 8,300 LoC (154 lemmas, 38 theorems) and took 10 days, consuming 2.8 billion tokens on Opus 4.6.

Repo, LinkedIn post.

Two things that might be unusual about this project:
The theorem is new. The mathematical proof was generated by Gemini DeepThink and verified by hand before formalization began. It has not yet been published. The paper is in preparation -- one of the few examples when the formalization process was completed before all paper co-authors signed off on the paper.
The formalization was semi-autonomous. I directed the mathematical architecture and enforced honest hypothesis management (~230 interactive prompts over 10 days), but the Lean code was written by Claude Code and hard lemmas were proved by Aristotle (220 submissions: 111 proved, 28 disproved — the negations caught false conjectures early).

The README has all code, a detailed development timeline, visualizations, and the full set of human prompts. I collected lots of fun stats about the formalization process!
